doc.title: Roscoe Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2023

chapter: Performing and the idea of free jazz
title: Rowe on Mitchell's recognition; never finished learning
summary: Rowe says Mitchell has triumphed too; Mitchell answers that one is finished when the head is too big to learn.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Being honored: NEA Jazz Masters and other awards

blocks.x: Well I would venture that I could say the same thing about you.
What would you say about me?

I would say that you spent a great deal of time and energy developing your own style and that when I look at your output and the acknowledgement that you’ve gotten from, through NEA Jazz Master and other recognitions that you have triumphed also.

Well you know I mean I haven’t triumphed until the end. I mean like you know you can’t — once you get to the point where your head has got so big that you don’t think you can learn anything you’re finished. That’s it. You’re finished. Like I said, again, a good day for me is when I can wake up and learn something. That’s a good day.
Well this has been a good day for me in that regard then. So thank you for sharing that.
